newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK bourse eyes regional convertibles, warrants.
newsitem.headline: HK bourse eyes regional convertibles, warrants.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said on Monday its Working Group on New Market Development had recommended the near-term introduction of a new trading facility for convertible bonds and derivative warrants on listed securities issued by companies in the Asia-Pacific region.

A preliminary list of exchanges to be recognised for the purposes of the new market included the stock exchanges of Australia, Jakarta, Korea, Kuala Lumpur, Bombay, India, New Zealand, Osaka, the Philippines, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Singapore, Thailand, Taiwan and Tokyo, it said.
Suitability for listing of any product would be determined on a case by case basis, the exchange said.

Both regional convertible bond and regional derivative warrant issuers would be required to demonstrate that there was or was likely to be significant investor interest in Hong Kong for the product as well as appropriate underlying turnover in the primary market, it said.
The exchange further invited issuers and their advisors to submit proposals to facilitate development of the new market.
